text.description_html:
MNG 175, Park Avenue 3 Inch Cabinet Pulls

The Park Avenue 3 Inch Cabinet Pull is made with the historic beauty of the iconic street after which it is named. This cabinet pull can be mounted with either 3 inch mounting centers or 3.25 inch mounting centers. The Park Avenue Pull is available in polished nickel, satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Traditional hardware like the Park Avenue 3 Inch Cabinet Pull will add high-class style to your home.

This cabinet pull is part of the MNG Park Avenue Collection.

Specifications and Features of the MNG 175 Park Avenue 3 Inch Cup Pull:

  • Base Material: Zinc
  • Length c.c. (center to center): Adjustable 3" or 3-1/4"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Sold Individually
